notes: kb/Work PB5925 (listing step 4a of docs/rearchitecture/DESIGN-listing.md, 2026-11-18). §2023:7.3.18.3 GR1: "Whether the compiler produces a source listing is implementor-defined. If the compiler does not produce a source listing, the LISTING directive shall be ignored." Half 1: WiseOwl COBOL produces a listing on request at 2002, 2014 and 2023 and by default at COBOL-85 (A.1 item 117, docs/manual/user-guide/listing.md). Half 2: with no listing (the default from 2002) the directive is processed by the driver, whose LISTING state only the listing reads, so it has no effect: the golden pb725_directive_facility compiles >>LISTING ON with no effect on the run, and the witness Listing2023Tests shows the state acting when a listing is produced.
